hooks.name: Review IRC protocol changes against the spec

action.prompt: An IRC protocol file was just changed. Compare the change with .kiro/specs/irc-core/requirements.md. Check that outgoing lines still stay within 512 bytes, CR/LF/NUL are stripped, numerics match RFC 2812, and NOTICE never triggers automatic replies. Report any requirement that is no longer met and suggest a test for it. Do not edit files.
